# StoryJumper

> StoryJumper is a digital publishing platform that empowers students, teachers, and families to create, publish, and share custom storybooks with multimedia content.

StoryJumper serves K-12 educators, parents, and young authors by providing an intuitive book creation tool that supports collaborative writing, digital storytelling, and professional publishing options including hardcover, paperback, and eBook formats. The platform emphasizes student engagement, creative expression, and compliance with children's privacy regulations like COPPA and GDPR.

## Key Topics

- Book creation and publishing
- Digital storytelling
- Student engagement
- Educational tool
- Creative writing
- Collaborative writing
- Multimedia storytelling
- Google Classroom integration
- COPPA compliance
- GDPR compliance
- Independent accounts
- Educational accounts
- iPad support
- QR codes
- Digital publishing

## Getting Started

- [StoryJumper: #1 rated site for creating story books](https://www.storyjumper.com): Homepage for StoryJumper's storybook creation and publishing platform
- [Author's Guide - Easiest way to create and publish your own book | StoryJumper](https://www.storyjumper.com/book/create): Comprehensive guide for creating and publishing books on StoryJumper

## For Educators

- [Why Teachers Love StoryJumper](https://www.storyjumper.com/school): Educational platform for K-12 teachers to enable student publishing
- [Teacher's Guide | StoryJumper](https://www.storyjumper.com/main/classroom): Teacher guide for classroom setup, lesson planning, and student publishing

## For Families

- [Create a Brighter Future for your Kids](https://www.storyjumper.com/parents): Family-focused storytelling platform for parents and children

## Publishing & Pricing

- [Price List | StoryJumper](https://www.storyjumper.com/prices): Pricing for hardcover, paperback, video books, and eBook options
- [Published Authors Gallery | StoryJumper](https://www.storyjumper.com/publishedAuthors): Showcase gallery featuring top published authors and community
